summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto f9f8d38e (#953 merged). The pin at 60fecde9 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. REBASE INTEGRITY PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: 633 changed content lines compared after stripping blob-hash and hunk-offset lines — BYTE-IDENTICAL to the head I pinned, so the review stands unchanged. READ-ONLY ANALYSIS HARNESS; no runtime code, no deploy, no restart. THE DESIGN IS RIGHT FOR THE REASON THAT MATTERS: it does NOT assume which shape ThinkOrSwim uses. It builds THREE models and reports all of them — an independent model of our live 04:00 ET reset including its 90-second gap guard, Modified ATR with a 04:00 ET reset and no live-only gap guard, and Modified ATR over continuous history — and states outright that chart session settings are part of the input. That is how you LOCATE a divergence rather than manufacture agreement. It cites ThinkOrSwim's own WildersAverage reference for the seven-length input prefetch instead of inferring the seed. IT DIRECTLY ADDRESSES THE TRAP I FLAGGED: our ATR is SESSION-SLICED at 04:00 ET and atr_oracle is NOT, so a comparison against the wrong internal model diverges for that reason alone and proves nothing. Modelling the sliced and continuous variants side by side is what makes any result interpretable. MUTATION: neutering session_anchor_ms turns 3 controls red, including test_session_sliced_model_resets_at_0400_et_while_continuous and test_real_live_method_matches_independent_live_model — so both the slice boundary and the agreement between the harness and the real live method are pinned. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base f9f8d38e: base 46 failed / 3755 passed, head 46 failed / 3767 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, base worktree existence verified before trusting the comparison. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. ⛔ STANDING CONSTRAINTS THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH THIS TOOL, recorded here because they will outlive the conversation that produced them: (1) THE OPERATOR HAS RULED TWICE that we do not ask him for another number or screenshot — this is our program and we prove it from our own bars and our own code. This harness is what makes that possible; do not regress to asking him. (2) ATR IS RECURSIVE, so one matching bar proves that bar and nothing else. The earlier claim that our trail reproduced at 5.4736 was WITHDRAWN for exactly that reason. Any result from this tool must state which SERIES, which INITIALISATION and which SESSION TREATMENT it matched before anyone calls the TOS item closed. (3) No heavy historical analysis during market hours — the bars live on the trading box. No blocking findings.
